_doc: Research v2 candidates, snapshot 2026-11-08. last_push = date of latest commit on the default branch (commits.atom) or GitHub API pushed_at. License read from the raw LICENSE file. 'verified: true' means the Wally name and version were read from the public Wally registry API (api.wally.run/v1/package-metadata) and, where present, the repo's wally.toml; for tools it means the GitHub release tag was read. Nothing was installed or executed. See docs/references/research-v2.md.

candidates.name: ProfileStore
candidates.notes: Session-locked DataStore wrapper. Make it the real default in templates (currently a commented line); keep PlayerDataService as the teaching reference only.

candidates.name: Lyra
candidates.notes: Migrations, transactions, large-data sharding. Repo wally.toml says 0.6.1 but registry latest is 0.6.0. Offer as alternative to ProfileStore.

candidates.name: DocumentService
candidates.notes: Schema-validated, session-locked documents. Mention as third option; do not ship three defaults.

candidates.name: Replica
candidates.notes: Not found on Wally under madstudioroblox/replica or loleris/replica. Reimplement the subscribe-player-to-state pattern in library/Systems replication helper, or document manual install.

candidates.name: ReplicaService
candidates.notes: Superseded by Replica.

candidates.name: Charm + charm-sync
candidates.notes: Atom state; littensy/charm-sync@0.4.1 replicates atoms server to client; littensy/react-charm@0.4.1 for React. Best maintained state+sync option.

candidates.name: Reflex
candidates.notes: Redux-style producers; author now favours Charm.

candidates.name: Promise
candidates.notes: Stable, quiet. Optional dependency; library itself should stay callback/task based.

candidates.name: t
candidates.notes: Runtime type checker. Overlaps library Util/Validate; keep ours (range/size limits for remotes). Also: rename library tests/lib/t.luau to avoid confusion with this package.

candidates.name: Janitor
candidates.notes: Overlaps Util/Trove. Link as alternative.

candidates.name: RbxUtil (Trove, Signal, Comm, Component, Input, Timer, Streamable, Log, BufferUtil, TableUtil)
candidates.notes: Verified: sleitnick/signal@2.0.3, sleitnick/trove@1.8.0, sleitnick/comm@1.0.1, sleitnick/component@2.4.8, sleitnick/input@3.0.0, sleitnick/timer@2.0.0, sleitnick/streamable@1.2.4, sleitnick/log@0.1.2, sleitnick/buffer-util@0.3.2, sleitnick/table-util@1.2.1. Recommend component + input + streamable as optional deps; keep our tiny Signal/Trove (or switch to these) but stop copying them into every template.

candidates.name: LemonSignal
candidates.notes: Fast signal; reference for benchmarking our Signal.

candidates.name: Squash
candidates.notes: Buffer serialization; useful only with hand-rolled networking. Blink covers most needs.

candidates.name: Sift
candidates.notes: Immutable table utils. Repo moved from csqrl to cxmeel; Wally name unchanged. Pre-1.0.

candidates.name: NevermoreEngine
candidates.notes: npm-distributed (@quenty/*); Wally only has canary builds (quenty/maid@2.0.1-canary...). Very active. Borrow concepts: ServiceBag DI, Binder (tag to class), Brio, Blend. Too heavy to adopt wholesale.

candidates.name: Knit
candidates.notes: Archived. Our Loader + Services pattern already covers it.

candidates.name: jecs
candidates.notes: Optional ECS. Mention in roblox-architecture; no template needs it.

candidates.name: React (react-lua)
candidates.notes: Also jsdotlua/react-roblox@17.2.1. Roblox itself publishes roblox/react@17.3.x (used by jest-roblox). Link as the 'large team' UI option; UrkUI stays tag/attribute driven.

candidates.name: Fusion
candidates.notes: Registry latest 0.3.0; repo main is 0.4.0-dev1 (breaking). Link only.

candidates.name: Vide
candidates.notes: Small fine-grained reactive UI; best fit if UrkUI ever wants reactivity. Borrow source/effect concepts rather than writing our own reactive core.

candidates.name: Iris
candidates.notes: Immediate-mode debug UI. Add as a dev-dependency for a debug panel in templates (Studio/admin only).

candidates.name: UI Labs (plugin) + ui-labs utility
candidates.notes: Story/storybook previewer. Use the plugin (not redistributed) and the MIT utility package as dev-dependency to write *.story.luau for UrkUI components.

candidates.name: Hoarcekat
candidates.notes: Older story viewer; UI Labs supersedes. Not on Wally registry.

candidates.name: Cmdr
candidates.notes: Admin/debug console with typed args and server-side permission hooks. Add as optional template module with a group/userId permission hook.

candidates.name: Conch
candidates.notes: Newer console. Repo wally.toml still says alo/conch@0.1.0; registry has alicesaidhi/conch@0.4.0. Also on pesde.

candidates.name: TopbarPlus
candidates.license: Custom (MIT-like plus credit requirement: keep attribute or credit in experience description)
candidates.notes: Not OSI; attribution obligation. Fine for users to add, never bundle in library/.

candidates.name: ZonePlus
candidates.notes: Repo wally.toml declares 1foreverhd/zoneplus@3.2.0 but it is not on the registry; stale. Reimplement a small Zone system (GetPartBoundsInBox/OverlapParams, polling) in library/Systems.

candidates.name: ripple
candidates.notes: Springs/tweens for UI motion; maintained replacement for Flipper.

candidates.name: spr
candidates.notes: Single-file spring; not found on Wally. Reimplement a damped spring in UrkUI or use ripple.

candidates.name: Flipper
candidates.notes: Unmaintained since 2021.

candidates.name: Blink
candidates.notes: IDL to buffer-packed remotes with type checks. Recommend as the one IDL (pick Blink over Zap: more active). Add an opt-in template overlay.

candidates.name: Zap
candidates.notes: Equivalent IDL; keep link only to avoid two defaults.

candidates.name: ByteNet
candidates.notes: Registry name ffrostflame/bytenet@0.4.6 differs from repo (ffrostfall/bytenet@0.5.0 unpublished). Quiet; Blink preferred.

candidates.name: Packet (Suphi)
candidates.notes: Distributed via DevForum/Creator Store model, no Git repo found; cannot pin or audit.

candidates.name: Roblox/jest-roblox
candidates.notes: Also roblox/jest-globals@3.20.1. The maintained Jest. Kit's testing skill wrongly calls jsdotlua Jest-Lua 'actively maintained'; fix.

candidates.name: jsdotlua/jest-lua
candidates.notes: Stale fork; use roblox/jest.

candidates.name: rocale-cli
candidates.notes: Official CLI: builds a Rojo project/.rbxl, uploads, runs a Luau entrypoint through Open Cloud Luau Execution, returns output. README documents Foreman install; Rokit pin unverified (release tag v0.1.3 verified). Needs API key with universe-places:write and luau-execution-sessions:write. Use for opt-in in-engine Jest in CI against a dedicated test place.

candidates.name: place-ci-cd-demo
candidates.notes: Archived official demo of Rojo + Luau Execution in GitHub Actions; copy the concurrency-group pattern (max 2 concurrent tasks per universe).

candidates.name: run-in-roblox
candidates.notes: Needs local Studio; stale. Replace mentions with rocale-cli / Luau Execution.

candidates.name: rbxcloud
candidates.notes: Open Cloud CLI: place publish, datastores, messaging. Use for a permission-gated publish script; slower maintenance.

candidates.name: Mantle
candidates.notes: Declarative IaC: places, environments (staging/prod), game passes, dev products, badges, icons/thumbnails with state file. Strong fit for a release workflow; must stay behind explicit publish permission. Some features use cookie auth, prefer Open Cloud key paths.

candidates.name: Asphalt
candidates.notes: Syncs local images/audio/models to Roblox via Open Cloud, writes a Luau/TS asset-id module, lockfile avoids re-uploads, can pack image atlases. Fills the kit's biggest automation gap (pipeline output and icons to asset ids).

candidates.name: Tarmac
candidates.notes: Predecessor of Asphalt, low activity.

candidates.name: darklua
candidates.notes: Rewrite string requires/aliases to instance paths, strip/minify, inject globals (e.g. __DEV__). Use when shipping library/ as an .rbxm or to Creator Store.

candidates.name: Argon
candidates.notes: Rojo alternative with two-way sync. Link only; Rojo stays default.

candidates.name: Rokit
candidates.notes: Already the kit's toolchain manager. Use it in CI too instead of curl+unzip.

candidates.name: Foreman
candidates.notes: Still updated (v1.7.0); rocale-cli docs use it. Doctor should detect foreman.toml in existing projects.

candidates.name: Aftman
candidates.notes: Archived; Rokit reads aftman.toml.

candidates.name: pesde
candidates.notes: Newer package manager (Roblox + Lune + Luau targets, can depend on Wally packages). Watch; Wally remains default.

candidates.name: luau-lsp
candidates.notes: Already pinned. Use `luau-lsp analyze --sourcemap --definitions` in CI over all of src (adapters too), not only luau-analyze on Logic.

candidates.name: Lune
candidates.notes: Already pinned; also usable for .rbxl inspection scripts (roblox library) in CI.

candidates.name: moonwave
candidates.notes: npm CLI (v1.4.2), not a Rokit tool. Generates a Docusaurus API site from --[=[ ]=] doc comments. Adopt for library/ docs; Node is an optional dependency only for docs builds.

candidates.name: roblox-ts
candidates.notes: v3.0.0. Out of scope (kit is Luau-first). Mention in docs only.

candidates.name: Roblox Blender Plugin
candidates.notes: Official add-on (v1.0.5) uploading meshes from Blender via Roblox OAuth. User signs in. Document as the manual upload route; scripted route is Asphalt/Open Cloud.

candidates.name: Roblox Studio built-in MCP
candidates.notes: 26 tools incl. execute_luau, start_stop_play, get_console_output, screen_capture, character_navigation, insert_asset, generate_mesh, list_roblox_studios. Kit config only has the macOS path; add Windows (cmd.exe /c %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat) and update the roblox-studio-mcp skill tool list.

candidates.name: studio-rust-mcp-server
candidates.notes: Archived; superseded by built-in server.

candidates.name: robloxstudio-mcp (boshyxd)
candidates.notes: v2.7.0 community fallback; requires its own Studio plugin, review before use.

candidates.name: rbx-studio-mcp (EL4CTEO)
candidates.notes: v1.0.6, 14 stars, brand new: 35 tools, editor-safe script edits. Watch; review plugin code before recommending.

candidates.name: GameAnalytics Roblox SDK
candidates.notes: Optional external analytics. Default should be a thin library wrapper over built-in AnalyticsService (economy, funnel, progression, custom events).

candidates.name: Lucide
candidates.notes: Release 1.70.0. UI icon default for UrkUI: rasterize SVG to PNG atlas at build time, keep license text in Icons/LICENSES.

candidates.name: Tabler Icons
candidates.notes: v3.50.0, 5000+ icons with filled variants.

candidates.name: Phosphor (core)
candidates.notes: v2.0.8; six weights incl. bold/fill, good for chunky Roblox look.

candidates.name: Material Symbols / Icons
candidates.notes: Large repo; fetch individual SVGs, include NOTICE. Optional set.

candidates.name: Kenney Game Icons
candidates.notes: 105 files, CC0, game-style glyphs. Also other Kenney UI packs (CC0). No attribution needed.

candidates.name: game-icons.net
candidates.notes: 4000+ RPG icons; attribution per author required (in-game credits). Keep out of default atlas; opt-in with generated CREDITS.

candidates.name: Roblox creator-docs
candidates.notes: Already used; also source of API dump for luau-lsp definitions.
